item.text:
It provides basic order helpers: totals line items, applies percentage codes, computes an “average,” and formats an order receipt.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; its final iteration accesses `items[items.length]` (undefined) and throws. Use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides the order total (price × quantity) by number of distinct items, so it is not an average item/unit price when quantities differ. It also returns `NaN` for an empty array.
